I have farmed this small piece of land since I was a girl, and I will not buy chemical fertilizer from the shop because one bag is too much for my tiny plot and I do not have that money at my age. I will spread manure from home because my mother taught me that way and it costs nothing. I will plant maize seed I kept from last year, and my children will help me so we do all the work ourselves with hoes. I will not spray any chemicals and I will not irrigate; I will wait for the rains to come.
